answer: The oasis register is checked at draw time, jade lists the eligible set, and echo seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 88 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 88 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 236 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
